svg.aria-label: Four rules for casting shadows by hand
svg.title: Four rules for casting shadows by hand

g.text: The shadow runs along the bearing,
parallel shadows, L = H / tan ALT.
At the wall the shadow turns and
climbs it vertically: it stays in the
Its shadow on the ground is parallel
and equally long: copy the edge,
Its shadow starts where it touches
the wall. Edges perpendicular to the
wall cast parallel shadows on it.
